Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc sold 2,694 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 48,205 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.16 million, down from 50,899 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
